tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba'i lo dpal sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod gser khrir zhal dro'i skabs kyi shis brjod dang dge 'dun la snyan sgron yi ge ngo mtshar snang gsal zhugs so// oṃ na mo bh+rūṃ ā yur+dzña na hrīḥ ā ro lika hūm̐ hrīḥ chu sbrul smin zla'i tshes bdun pa nang phrod nyin lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod gser khrir mnga' gsol shis brjod/ khri gdan bcu pa lta ba dang sbrags/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi rnam thar bltas pas sa skya bka' 'bum sogs zab chos mang po gsan skabs dang / de dus nged rang la mtsho sngon nor bu skyabs sogs kyi skyes bskur ba'i lan 'debs gras 'jam dbyangs ril bu ster pa sogs la nye bzang po byung zhing / shis brjod dngos ni 'di ltar te/ 'chi med grub gnyis char 'bebs tshe dpag med/ /rnam par rgyal ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang / /gzhan yang snod bcud 'chi med dngos grub kyis/ /mkhas btsun bzang brgyud 'byor khrir shis pas skyongs/ /'jam dbyangs rigs thig 'khon ston sa skya'i gdung / /bdud kyi stobs 'phrog rgyal ba'i yon tan mchog /stobs bcu'i dpal ldan gnyis 'thung dbang po'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag brtan srid zhi'i dpal 'bar shog /ngag gi dbang phyug 'khon ston sa skya pa/ /lta ngan ri dwags kun 'jom ma 'dres chos/ /mi 'jigs yon tan bzhi ldan seng ge'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /snyan grags kun gsal rje btsun sa skya pa/ /bla med thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du/ /myur mgyogs rdzu 'phrul rkang ldan rta mchog khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rje btsun sa skya pa/ /'chi med tshe yi dpal la dbang ba po/ /dbang bcu kun ldan yid 'ong rma bya'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /mtshungs bral sngags 'chang rje btsun sa skya pa/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing kun skad cig gi /bgrod la thogs pa mi mnga' mkha' lding khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞

/mkhyen rab dbang phyug rje btsun sa skya pa/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du/ /legs skong bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po'i khrir/ /myur byon༞ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid rje btsun sa skya pa/ /kun tu chags pa'i skyon spangs pad+mo che/ /rab rgyas lhun stug ze'u 'bru bzhad pa'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa/ /mi shes smag rum mthar byed rang bzhin gyi/ /'od gsal nyin byed dbang po rgyas pa'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /yon tan mchog mnga' rje btsun sa skya pa/ /legs byas cha shas yongs gang bsil zer gyis/ /skye dgu'i gdung sel rab dkar zla ba'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag༞ /'phrin las mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa/ /grangs med nyes pa'i tshogs kyis mi brdzi zhing / /phyogs las rnam rgyal gzhom bral rdo rje'i khrir/ /myur byon rtag brtan srid zhi'i dbang 'bar shog /zhes 'jam mgon a mes zhabs la zhabs brtan gsol 'debs thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i mkhan rab bcu gcig pa byams pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho'i mdzad par tshig zur cung zad bcos shing sngon du sh+lau ka gcig spar te sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i dge 'dun tshogs dbur dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud mkhas grub du ma srid mtha'i bar du byon nas srid zhi'i dge legs stsol ba'i rten 'brel du gser khri gsar bzhengs zhal dror sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros rang gi rigs kyi zung dang bcas 'dug nas a li chos rje'i lung par mdo sngags bstan pa rang lugs ltar spel ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas dbang phyug dang / byams pa phun tshogs sogs kyi 'bul chen blang zhing bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod tshogs gzungs byin chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi smon lam dang bcas bton dus shis brjod 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba'i dge bas re smon ji bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

༄༅/ /oṃ pa ra ma sadhi ku ru/ 'chi med dpal 'byor sprul pa'i khang bzang du/ /'chi med dpal 'byor rin chen chos khri 'dir/ /'chi med dpal 'byor 'jam mgon gdung byon nas/ /'chi med dpal 'byor bstan 'gror rtag brtan shog /ces dge legs kyi tshig gis mdun drangs te/ de la 'dir/ rtsod dus gdul bya'i dpal mgon du bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos 'dzam bu'i sgra ldan gyi gling 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de dmu rgod gdul bya phal cher nye lam gyi rjes su bzung ba sogs bka' drin rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i rgyun de nyid gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul rgyal blon mkhas grub rim byon rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che dbu brnyes srol gtod/ snga dar phyi dar gyi tshul du spel bar mdzad pa rnams kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa zhes kun gyis bstod bkur bsngags pa de nyid dus phyis sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dkar po rnam gsum/ chos rje khu dbon rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa rin po che srid mtha'i bar du spel ba'i thugs bskyed rmad byung btsan pos chos srid dka' ba du mar bzod pa chen po'i rnam thar rgyal sras kun gyi 'gran zlar mdzad de/ bdud sprul sde dpon bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la gnod pa rnams lo zla ma 'gyangs par tshar bcad de/ gdan sa chen po'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu'i rgyun ji srid bskal par brtan par bzhugs phyir 'jam dbyangs sku mched gdung sras su bskrun par mdzad cing / chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha khang chen mo'i gling sogs dge 'dun gyi sde du mar mdo sngags 'chad spel gyi rgyun zhabs tog bzang po dang bcas 'dzugs par mdzad nas/

de dag gi cha rkyen chos gzhis/ 'bul tshong sgar khag sogs dang bcas par mdzad pa de nyid nas bzung / bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi bar du ma nyams dbyar mtsho ltar bzhugs pa la/ bdag cag spun nas kyang bzang po'i zhabs rjes ji bzhin dka' rung / 'on kyang bla ma dam pa yi dam chos srung sogs kyi thugs rje'i rgyun ma nyams tsam zhabs 'thud zhu thub pa 'di bzhin srid pa ji srid bar du brtan pa'i rten 'brel du thog mar zhal dro lha khang rten mchod cha bcas rnams bzhengs shing / lha khang chen mor yar 'gro'i skas ring dang snyan grags rnga chen gsar bzhengs kyi rten 'brel yang dga' mo byung khul dang / da lam dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud mkhas grub sngon gyi rje btsun gong ma rnams dang dbyer med chu klung chen po'i rgyun ltar byon nas bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad pa sha stag 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du/ sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di'i tshogs dbur bzhugs khri gsar bzhengs la kho bos gdan sa yun ring du bzung ba sogs zhal dro'i khul dang / de'i rigs kyi myu gu gnyis gzhon nu'i dus yin pa sogs slad kyi dge legs la cung zad phan nam snyam pa rnams khri 'dir thog mar sdod go gang ci'i legs cha sgrig dgos tshang mar nged rang nas bkod pas khyab par byas pa 'di bzhin la ma sgrig rang 'grig lta bur sngon nas mdo khams a li chos rje'i yul du rang lugs rgyu 'bras bstan pa rin po che spel bar mngags pa'i bla ma gsum nas bshad sgrub btsugs pa'i gtam snyan srid na dkon pa dang bcas 'di lo 'bul skyel dang rang nyid kyi 'byung khungs lta zhing / tshogs gsog sgrib sbyongs du 'byor ba'i dngos po rnams sngar srol bzang po ltar tshogs chen du 'bul 'dun dang / nged rang dog yol ba 'grig pas gzhan gyi'ang khri la legs skyes stobs pa dang sbrags de ring gi gnas skabs zhal dro 'di ltar lags pas/

slad nas kyang 'di lta bu'i legs lam la brten nas/ rje btsun gong ma dbang po'i grangs ldan gyi bka' srol la zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid sogs kyis thugs bskyed smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin mngon du gyur te dga' ston rgya chen rgyun 'khyongs su 'byung ba'i thugs 'dun dge 'dun tshang mas mdzad par zhu// //zhes gnas skabs kyi snyan sgron du gsol// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sa skya'i lha khang chen mor shis brjod dang dge 'dun la snyan sgron yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
